item.title: Neater Hugo Code Blocks
item.description:
Improving the appearance of Hugo code-blocks

One additional modification, I don’t like the way the code block is presented, ie, with no text wrapping - this skews the look of the page and i’m not a fan.

Modify the “code” block of themes/hugo-bearblog/partials/style.html to include the “wrap-text” arguement:

code {
    font-family: monospace;
    padding: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    text-wrap: wrap;
  }

item.title: Bear Blog Home Page Customisation
item.description:
Bear Blog Home Page Customisation

While not in its final form,

I want to be able to add some customision to the stadard Hugo Bear Blog home page, specifically adding in some header text and a break down of blog posts made in certain categories.

{{ define "main" }}
  {{ .Content }}

  <h3>Technology</h3>
  <ul class="blog-posts">
    {{ range first 5 (where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "posts") "Params.categories" "intersect" (slice "technology")) }}
    <li>
        <span>
          <i>
            <time datetime="{{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}">{{ .Date.Format "02 Jan 2006" }}</time>
          </i>
        </span>
        <a href="{{ .RelPermalink }}">{{ .Title }}</a>
      </li>
    {{ end }}
  </ul>
  </ul>

{{ end }}

Improving the appearance of Hugo code-blocks

One additional modification, I don’t like the way the code block is presented, ie, with no text wrapping - this skews the look of the page and i’m not a fan.
